project.name: Cubeage Game SDK
project.summary: Source SDK package repository for Cubeage Platform integrations across Unity, Cocos Creator, and Solar2D games.
goals: Own the Unity, Cocos Creator, and Solar2D SDK source packages in this repository.
Provide game-client integration primitives for Cubeage auth, sessions, analytics, purchases, attribution, force-update checks, and offline queueing.
Preserve explicitly implemented legacy-token migration behavior for supported engine SDKs.
nonGoals: Own backend platform API behavior, billing validation services, or analytics storage.
Own game-specific feature logic, economy behavior, UI content, or product experiments.
Own the newer Android/iOS native SDK v3 release workflow.

owns.name: unity-game-sdk
owns.description: Unity source package and runtime API under Unity/Assets/CubeageSDK.

owns.name: cocos-game-sdk
owns.description: Cocos Creator TypeScript SDK source and configuration surface under Cocos/.

owns.name: solar2d-game-sdk
owns.description: Solar2D Lua SDK source and configuration surface under Solar2D/.

owns.name: legacy-token-migration
owns.description: SDK-local migration helpers for supported legacy client tokens and storage keys.

doesNotOwn: Cubeage backend platform API behavior, storage, billing validation, or analytics processing.
Host game feature logic, economy tuning, UI content, or product experiments.
Android/iOS native SDK v3 release artifacts and GitHub Release workflow.

allowedDependencies.surface: Cubeage platform HTTP/API contract consumed by SDK clients
documented native SDK package/release surfaces only

forbiddenCouplings: Do not add game-specific feature logic, economy tuning, UI content, or product experiments to the SDK core.
Do not reach into backend repository internals instead of consuming documented API contracts.
Do not treat this legacy/source SDK repo as the owner of the native SDK v3 release train.

delivery.deployPath: Source SDK changes land on main; no CI workflow, registry publication workflow, or GitHub Release workflow is configured in this repository.
delivery.productionProof: Runtime SDK changes require source readback plus host-game or engine-level integration smoke proof before production use. Manifest-only changes are proven by doctrine project-control audit.

gaps.description: Repository has no CI workflow for SDK package validation.
Unity package metadata is versioned in source, but no bot-owned package release or registry/provenance workflow is configured.
